Title: App launches to Discover
Steps:
1. Launch MiniCast from the launcher.
2. Wait for the Featured list.
Expected Result:
- Discover opens with the search field and 6 shows.
- No crash or ANR.
Actual Result: Cold start reached Discover in under half a second. No crash.

Title: Catalog content is correct
Test Data: 6 shows - see Appendix A
Steps: 1. Read each row: show name, author, episode count.
Expected Result: - All 6 rows match the catalog. Counts read 5,4,4,5,4,4.
Actual Result: All six shows present with the right authors and episode counts (5, 4, 4, 5, 4, 4).

Title: Basic playback works
Test Data: The Great Password Purge
Steps:
1. Open The Daily Byte > The Great Password Purge.
2. Listen. Open Now Playing from the mini-player.
Expected Result:
- Audio plays, counting up from zero.
- Timer ticks, duration shows 0:30.
Actual Result: Audio played from the start, timer ticked, duration read 0:30. Counting confirmed by ear.

Title: Media notification appears
Steps: 1. Pull down the notification shade.
Expected Result: - MiniCast notification with episode title, show name and transport controls.
Actual Result: Notification showed the episode title, show name and transport controls.

Title: Settings defaults
Steps: 1. Open Settings from the gear icon.
Expected Result: - Resume ON, speed 1x, sleep timer 10 min, sleep notification ON.
Actual Result: Resume ON, speed 1x, sleep timer 10 min, notification ON.

Title: Featured list loads
Steps: 1. Launch the app and watch the Featured area.
Expected Result:
- Loading indicator, then the 6 shows.
- No blank screen or error flash.
Actual Result: Loading state, then all six shows. Content matched the catalog.

Title: Search needs 2 characters
Test Data: 't', then 'th'
Steps:
1. Type a single character in search. Wait.
2. Add a second character.
Expected Result:
- 1 char: nothing happens, Featured list stays.
- 2 chars: returns The Daily Byte and True North Tales.
Actual Result: One character did nothing. 'th' returned The Daily Byte and True North Tales.

Title: Search matches title and author
Test Data: See test data below
Steps:
1. Search 'mi'. Clear.
2. Search 'MINDFUL'. Clear.
3. Search 'media', then 'radio', then 'wander'. Clear between each.
4. Search 'technology' and 'travel'.
Expected Result:
- 'mi' and 'MINDFUL' both return Mindful Minutes - case doesn't matter.
- Author terms work: media > The Daily Byte, radio > Startup Stories, wander > True North Tales.
- Genre terms return 'No shows found'. Flag to PO - genre isn't searchable.
Actual Result: media, radio, wander and lab each matched the right show by author. technology and travel returned 'No shows found' - genre is not searched. Raised with the PO rather than filed.

Title: No results state
Test Data: 'zz'
Steps: 1. Search 'zz'.
Expected Result: - 'No shows found'. No error, no retry button.
Actual Result: 'zz' showed 'No shows found'. No error, no retry.

Title: Clearing search restores Featured
Test Data: 'th'
Steps:
1. Search 'th'.
2. Delete one character, then the rest.
Expected Result: - Featured list comes back. No stale results left behind.
Actual Result: Deleting to one character and then to empty restored the Featured list both times.

Title: Fast retyping doesn't show stale results
Test Data: 'history' then 'mindful'
Steps:
1. Type 'history', then immediately clear and type 'mindful' before results appear.
2. Wait 5s.
Expected Result: - Only Mindful Minutes shown. The older query never wins.
Actual Result: Typing 'history' and immediately replacing it with 'mindful' settled on Mindful Minutes only.

Title: Odd input doesn't break search
Test Data: spaces, %, --, 200-char string
Steps:
1. Enter two spaces. Then '%'. Then '--'. Then a very long string.
2. Clear fully between each.
Expected Result:
- No crash, layout holds.
- Each input gives a defined result (empty state or Featured).
Actual Result: Two spaces, %, -- and a 200-character string all handled. Empty state shown, layout intact, no crash.

Title: Multi-word search
Test Data: 'daily byte', 'byte media'
Steps:
1. Search 'daily byte'. Clear.
2. Search 'byte media' - spans title and author.
Expected Result: - Both return The Daily Byte.
Actual Result: 'daily byte', 'the daily' and 'byte media' all returned The Daily Byte.

Title: Back dismisses keyboard, keeps the query
Test Data: 'th'
Steps: 1. Press Back once.
Expected Result: - Keyboard closes. Still on Discover with 'th' and its results.
Actual Result: Back closed the keyboard. Query and both results stayed on screen.

Title: Episode lists are correct
Test Data: All 6 shows - Appendix A
Steps:
1. Open each show in turn.
2. Check episode titles, dates and durations against the catalog.
Expected Result:
- All 26 episodes correct.
- Header shows right author, genre, episode count.
- Newest episode first.
Actual Result: All 26 episodes across the six shows matched on title, date and episode count.

Title: Duration and date formatting
Steps: 1. Read the durations and dates on the episode rows.
Expected Result:
- Durations read 0:10, 0:30, 1:00 - not 0:60.
- Dates read 'Aug 18, 2026' / 'Aug 4, 2026'.
Actual Result: Durations read 0:10, 0:30 and 1:00. Dates read Aug 18, 2026 and Aug 4, 2026.

Title: Episode list loading
Test Data: Mindful Minutes
Steps: 1. Tap a show and watch the list area.
Expected Result: - Loading state, then the episodes. Header and back arrow usable straight away.
Actual Result: Episode list appeared after the loading delay; header and back arrow usable immediately.

Title: Back keeps the search results
Test Data: 'th' > True North Tales
Steps: 1. Search 'th', open True North Tales, press back.
Expected Result: - Back on Discover with 'th' still in the field and both results showing.
Actual Result: Back from the show kept 'th' in the field and both results on screen.

Title: Switching shows quickly
Test Data: The Daily Byte then History Rewind
Steps: 1. Open The Daily Byte, go back immediately, open History Rewind before the first list renders.
Expected Result: - Only History Rewind episodes shown. No Daily Byte content bleeds through.
Actual Result: Opening a second show before the first had rendered showed History Rewind only.

Title: Mini-player doesn't cover the last episode
Test Data: Startup Stories (5 episodes)
Steps:
1. Start any episode so the mini-player shows.
2. Open Startup Stories and scroll to the bottom.
3. Tap the last row.
Expected Result: - Last episode fully visible above the mini-player and tappable.

Title: Audio, timer and system state agree
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now (1:00)
Steps:
1. Play the episode and open Now Playing.
2. At three points, note the spoken number and the timer.
3. Cross-check with the media session (Appendix B).
Expected Result: - Spoken number, on-screen timer and system position all match within a second.
Actual Result: Timer matched the player at all three samples - 0:22, 0:30 and 0:39. Spoken number confirmed by ear.

Title: Pause and resume
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. Pause at around 0:08.
2. Wait 6s, watching the timer.
3. Resume.
Expected Result:
- Audio stops, timer frozen.
- Media session reports PAUSED.
- Resumes from the same point.
Actual Result: Audio stopped, timer froze, and it resumed from the same point - but the app keeps reporting itself as playing, so the notification still offers Pause. See BUG-001.

Title: Mini-player and Now Playing stay in sync
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. Go back to the show list and pause from the mini-player.
2. Open Now Playing.
Expected Result: - Both controls show Play. No disagreement between them.
Actual Result: Pausing from the mini-player left both it and Now Playing showing Play.

Title: End of episode
Test Data: The Off-By-One Episode
Steps:
1. Let it play to the end without touching anything.
2. Check the player, the mini-player and the notification.
Expected Result:
- Playback stops, no auto-advance to the next episode.
- Everything shows a stopped state - no ghost notification.
Actual Result: Stopped at the end, no auto-advance. Reported position runs a fraction past the episode length - see BUG-002.

Title: Replay after it finishes
Test Data: The Off-By-One Episode
Steps: 1. Press play on the finished episode.
Expected Result: - Starts again from 0:00.
Actual Result: Pressing play on a finished episode restarted it from 0:00.

Title: Switching episode mid-playback
Test Data: The Great Password Purge, then AI Writes Our Show Notes Now, then One Breath at a Time (Mindful Minutes)
Steps:
1. Play one episode, go back, tap a different one.
2. Repeat with an episode from another show.
Expected Result:
- Old audio stops immediately - never two streams.
- Title, show name and duration all update.
- Notification updates too.
Actual Result: Switching within the show and to another show updated the title, duration and show name.

Title: Buffering is visible
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps: 1. Tap an episode and watch until audio starts.
Expected Result: - Loading shown during the delay. Tap is clearly acknowledged.
Actual Result: Buffering shown for roughly three seconds before audio began.

Title: Double-tapping play/pause
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps: 1. Tap play/pause twice quickly. Repeat a few times.
Expected Result: - Settles in a sane state. Icon always matches whether audio is playing.
Actual Result: A fast double tap left the control and the audio in step.

Title: Volume and silent mode
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. Press volume down to zero, then back up.
2. Put the phone on silent.
Expected Result:
- Volume keys control the media stream; playback isn't interrupted.
- Silent mode does not mute media (correct Android behaviour).
Actual Result: Volume keys adjusted the media stream without interrupting playback. Silent mode not tried.

Title: Headphone unplug
Preconditions: Playing through wired or BT headphones
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps: 1. Unplug the headphones / disconnect the headset mid-playback.
Expected Result: - Playback pauses. Audio does not blast out of the speaker.

Title: Skip forward and back
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. At 0:10 tap +15s.
2. Let it run to 0:40, tap -15s.
Expected Result:
- 0:10 > 0:25 and 0:40 > 0:25.
- Spoken number matches the new position.
- Seek bar keeps moving forward smoothly after each skip - no jumping back.
Actual Result: +15s moved 30 seconds (0:26 to 0:56). -15s moved 15 correctly. See BUG-005.

Title: Skip clamps at both ends
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now (1:00), The Great Password Purge (0:30) and The Off-By-One Episode (0:10)
Steps:
1. At 0:05 tap -15s. Tap it a few more times at 0:00.
2. On the 0:30 episode, at 0:25 tap +15s.
3. On the 0:10 episode, tap +15s from the start.
Expected Result:
- Never goes below 0:00 or past the duration.
- No crash, no wrap-around.
- The 0:10 episode ends cleanly.
Actual Result: Clamps correctly at both ends - never below 0:00, never past the duration, and the 0:10 episode ends cleanly. The forward jump itself measured 30s, see BUG-005.

Title: Repeated skips
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps: 1. Tap +15s five times quickly.
Expected Result: - Lands at the end deterministically. No taps lost.
Actual Result: Repeated taps land at the end deterministically, though it got there in two taps rather than five because each jump is 30s - see BUG-005.

Title: Dragging the seek bar moves the audio
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. Drag the thumb to the middle.
2. Listen to the next spoken number.
3. Repeat at 25% and 75%.
Expected Result:
- Timer and audio both land near 0:30 / 0:15 / 0:45.
- If the timer moves but the audio carries on from before, that's a Sev-1 bug.
Actual Result: Dragging to 25%, 50% and 75% landed at 14s, 29s and 43s. Spoken number confirmed by ear.

Title: Seeking while paused
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps: 1. Drag the thumb to about 0:45 while paused, then press play.
Expected Result: - Resumes from 0:45, not 0:10.
Actual Result: Seeking to 43s while paused resumed from 43s, not from where it was paused.

Title: Seek to the very start and very end
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps: 1. Drag fully left, then fully right.
Expected Result:
- 0:00 replays from the beginning.
- Full right reaches the end cleanly.
Actual Result: Full left returned to the start, full right reached the end cleanly.

Title: 1.5x and 2x actually change the rate
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. Set 1.5x, play for 20s by the clock, pause. Note how far it moved.
2. Reset and repeat at 2x.
Expected Result:
- 1.5x moves about 30s of audio in 20s; 2x moves about 40s.
- Audio is audibly faster.
Actual Result: 1.5x moved 27s of audio in 20s of real time; 2x moved 36s. Both audibly faster.

Title: Speed button cycles
Steps: 1. Tap the speed button four times.
Expected Result: - 1x > 1.5x > 2x > 1x. Rate matches the label each time.
Actual Result: Cycled 1x, 1.5x, 2x and back to 1x, rate matching the label each time.

Title: Speed carries to the next episode
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now, then The Great Password Purge
Steps: 1. Set 2x, then start a different episode.
Expected Result:
- Behaviour is consistent - either keeps 2x or falls back to the Settings default.
- Label and actual rate always agree.
Actual Result: After playing at 2x, the next episode opened at 1x. Same on every run.

Title: Skip is 15 media seconds at any speed
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. At 2x, reach 0:20 and tap +15s.
2. Repeat at 1.5x.
Expected Result: - Jumps to 0:35 both times - 15 media seconds, not 7.5 or 30.
Actual Result: At both 2x and 1.5x the forward skip moved about 30 seconds instead of 15. See BUG-005.

Title: Resume picks up where you left off
Test Data: The Great Password Purge
Steps:
1. Play to about 0:18 and pause.
2. Force close the app and reopen it.
3. Play the same episode.
Expected Result: - Resumes near 0:18 with the matching spoken number.
Actual Result: Paused at 30s, reopened at 11s. Cannot be judged while BUG-003 stands.

Title: Resume survives the app being killed in the background
Test Data: The Great Password Purge
Steps:
1. Play to about 0:22, pause, press Home.
2. Kill the app from the background (Appendix B) and reopen from Recents.
3. Play the same episode.
Expected Result: - Resumes near 0:22. No crash on relaunch.
Actual Result: With Resume on, the position is not restored after the app is killed in the background. See BUG-011.

Title: Resume OFF starts from the beginning
Test Data: The Great Password Purge
Steps:
1. Turn Resume OFF in Settings.
2. Play to 0:18, force close, reopen.
3. Play the same episode.
Expected Result:
- Starts at 0:00.
- Toggle is still OFF.
Actual Result: With Resume off, played to 20s then opened a never-played episode: it started at 5s. See BUG-004.

Title: Each episode keeps its own position
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now (1:00), The Great Password Purge (0:30), The Pivot That Wasn't, from Startup Stories
Steps:
1. Play AI Writes Our Show Notes Now to about 25s and pause.
2. Open Great Password Purge - not played since install.
3. Open The Pivot That Wasn't - also not played.
4. Go back to AI Writes Our Show Notes Now.
Expected Result:
- Episodes never played start at 0:00.
- AI Writes Our Show Notes Now returns to its own 25s.
Actual Result: Clean install. Played AI Writes Our Show Notes Now to 27s; The Great Password Purge, never played, opened at 30s - its end. The Pivot That Wasn't opened at 13s. See BUG-003.

Title: Default speed applies to new playback
Steps:
1. Set default speed to 2x in Settings.
2. Force close, reopen, start an episode.
Expected Result: - Plays at 2x from the start; speed button shows 2x.

Title: Settings survive a restart
Test Data: speed 2x, sleep 15 min, notification OFF
Steps:
1. Change all three settings.
2. Force close and reopen. Open Settings.
Expected Result: - All three retain the new values.
Actual Result: Speed 2x, sleep 15 min and notification off all survived a force close and relaunch.

Title: Changing speed during playback
Steps: 1. While playing, change the default speed in Settings and come back.
Expected Result:
- Defined behaviour - applies now or on the next episode.
- Label and actual rate always match.

Title: Finished episode doesn't resume at the end
Test Data: The Off-By-One Episode
Steps: 1. Let it finish. Force close, reopen, open it again.
Expected Result: - Starts at 0:00, not stuck at the end.
Actual Result: Finished at 10s, reopened at 7s - neither the start nor the end. Blocked by BUG-003.

Title: Reinstall restores defaults
Steps: 1. Wipe app data (Appendix B) and reopen.
Expected Result:
- Resume ON, 1x, 10 min, notification ON.
- All saved positions gone.
Actual Result: Defaults correct after a reinstall. The usual wipe command is refused on this handset - see TEST-ENV-001.

Title: Arming and cancelling the timer
Preconditions: Episode playing, timer set to 10 min
Steps:
1. Tap Sleep timer.
2. Watch the label for a few seconds.
3. Tap it again.
Expected Result:
- Counts down from 9:59.
- Second tap cancels it; playback continues.

Title: 1-minute timer stops playback
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. Set 1 min in Settings, play an episode, arm the timer.
2. Leave it alone and time it.
Expected Result:
- Playback stops at 60s (+/- 2s).
- Timer label resets to 'Sleep timer'.

Title: Timer expiring exactly when the episode ends
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. Start the episode at 0:00 and arm the 1-min timer at the same moment.
2. Wait it out. Repeat 3 times.
Expected Result:
- No crash. Only one stop is handled.
- No leftover armed timer, no duplicate notification.
Actual Result: Timer and end of episode landed together at 60s. Playback stopped once, no crash, and the timer disarmed itself.

Title: Timer notification respects the setting
Steps:
1. With the notification setting ON, arm the timer and let it fire.
2. Turn the setting OFF and repeat.
Expected Result:
- ON: notification appears when it fires.
- OFF: playback still stops, no notification.

Title: Timer works in the background and with the screen off
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. Arm the timer, press Home, wait it out.
2. Repeat with the screen locked.
Expected Result: - Fires at 60s both times.

Title: Timer survives rotation
Steps: 1. Note the countdown, rotate to landscape and back.
Expected Result: - Countdown continues from the right value. Not reset, not cancelled.

Title: Changing the duration while armed
Steps: 1. Go to Settings, pick 1 min, return to the player.
Expected Result: - Countdown shown matches the duration that actually fires.

Title: Arming with nothing playing
Steps: 1. Pause an episode, then arm the timer.
Expected Result:
- Currently counts down against silence (OBS-1).
- At minimum must not crash or fire a phantom notification.

Title: Playback continues in the background
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. Press Home and listen for 20s.
2. Lock the screen and listen for another 20s.
Expected Result: - Audio continues uninterrupted both times.
Actual Result: Tested by hand. Audio continues with the app backgrounded and with the screen off.

Title: Notification controls work and stay in sync
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. Pause from the notification.
2. Resume from the notification.
3. Open the app.
Expected Result:
- Audio pauses and resumes from the same point.
- In-app control matches the notification.
Actual Result: Tested by hand. Pause and resume from the notification both work and the in-app control matches.

Title: Notification metadata updates
Test Data: Great Password Purge, then One Breath at a Time
Steps: 1. Check the notification, switch to an episode in a different show, check again.
Expected Result: - Title, show name and artwork all update. Only one notification at a time.

Title: Tapping the notification returns to the app
Steps:
1. Tap the notification body.
2. Press back a few times.
Expected Result:
- Returns to the screen you left, not a fresh Discover.
- Back walks the original stack - no duplicate screens.
Actual Result: Tested by hand. Tapping the notification returns to the screen that was open, no duplicate.

Title: Notification clears when playback stops
Test Data: The Off-By-One Episode
Steps: 1. Let it finish. Wait 10s. Check the shade.
Expected Result: - Notification removed or no longer ongoing. Nothing claims active playback.
Actual Result: Tested by hand. Notification clears once playback stops.

Title: Lock screen controls
Steps: 1. Lock the phone, wake the screen, use the lock-screen controls.
Expected Result: - Correct title and artwork. Pause and play both work.

Title: Playback works with notifications denied
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. Deny the notification permission and relaunch.
2. Play an episode, press Home, listen for 20s.
3. Arm a 1-min sleep timer.
Expected Result:
- Audio plays and keeps playing in the background.
- No crash.
- Sleep timer still stops playback; only the notification is missing.
Actual Result: Tested by hand. Playback and background playback both work with notifications denied. No crash.

Title: Removing the app from Recents
Steps: 1. Swipe MiniCast away from Recents. Listen.
Expected Result:
- Either playback stops and the notification clears, or it continues with a working notification.
- Never audio with no way to stop it.

Title: Headset media keys
Steps: 1. Send play/pause from a headset or media key.
Expected Result: - Toggles correctly and the in-app control agrees.

Title: Incoming call
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. Have someone call the device at about 0:15. Don't answer at first.
2. Answer, talk 15s, hang up.
Expected Result:
- Audio pauses on the first ring and stays paused for the whole call.
- Position preserved.
- After hanging up, behaviour is consistent - either auto-resumes from the same point or waits for play.
Actual Result: Tested by hand. Pauses on the incoming call, stays paused for its duration, resumes afterwards.

Title: Outgoing call
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps: 1. Place a call while an episode is playing.
Expected Result: - Pauses as soon as dialling starts. Same recovery as TC-8.1.
Actual Result: Tested by hand. Same behaviour on an outgoing call.

Title: Another app takes the audio
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps:
1. Start playback in another audio app.
2. Stop the other app.
Expected Result:
- MiniCast pauses - never two streams at once.
- Does not auto-resume when the other app stops.
Actual Result: Tested by hand. Another app taking the audio pauses MiniCast. No overlapping playback.

Title: Short interruption (notification sound, alarm)
Steps: 1. Trigger a notification sound, then a timer/alarm.
Expected Result: - Ducks or briefly pauses, then carries on. Not killed permanently.
Actual Result: Tested by hand. Stays paused while the alarm sounds and resumes once it is stopped.

Title: Interruption while loading
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps: 1. Tap an episode and take a call during the loading delay.
Expected Result: - No crash, no stuck spinner. State resolves after the call.

Title: Interruption right at the end of an episode
Test Data: The Off-By-One Episode
Steps: 1. Take a call at about 0:09. Repeat 3 times.
Expected Result: - No crash. One coherent end state, no ghost notification.

Title: Interruption with a sleep timer armed
Steps: 1. Take a 30s call 20s into the countdown.
Expected Result: - Timer behaviour is defined and the label reflects what will actually happen.

Title: Bluetooth connect / disconnect mid-playback
Steps: 1. Connect a BT headset, then disconnect it.
Expected Result:
- Audio moves across without restarting.
- Disconnect pauses rather than switching to speaker.

Title: Rotation during playback
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps: 1. Rotate to landscape and back while listening.
Expected Result:
- Audio doesn't glitch, stop or restart.
- Position, title, speed and seek bar all preserved.
- Landscape usable on every screen - nothing clipped or unreachable.
Actual Result: Timer snaps to 0:00 the moment the screen rotates and counts up again while the audio carries on from the real position. See BUG-006.

Title: Rotation while paused
Steps: 1. Rotate to landscape and back.
Expected Result: - Still paused at 0:20. Does not start playing on its own.
Actual Result: Paused at the end: the screen showed 1:00, then 0:00 after rotating, while the player stayed at 60s. See BUG-006.

Title: Rotation with a search active
Test Data: 'th'
Steps: 1. Rotate to landscape and back.
Expected Result: - Query and results survive. No reload, no revert to Featured.
Actual Result: Query and both results survived rotating in each direction.

Title: Rotation on Settings and show detail
Test Data: Startup Stories
Steps:
1. Scroll a show's episode list and rotate.
2. Change all four settings and rotate.
Expected Result:
- Scroll position and all setting values survive.
- No flash of defaults.
Actual Result: In landscape the Settings screen is cut off - 'Notify when sleep timer ends' is off screen and the screen will not scroll, so the setting cannot be reached. See BUG-007.

Title: Repeated rotation
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps: 1. Rotate back and forth ~10 times quickly.
Expected Result: - No crash, audio never breaks, memory doesn't climb.
Actual Result: Rotated back and forth repeatedly with no crash and no interruption to playback.

Title: App killed in the background and restored
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps: 1. Press Home, kill the app (Appendix B), reopen from Recents.
Expected Result:
- Restores without crashing.
- With Resume ON it returns to ~0:25.
Actual Result: With Resume on, reopening after the app was killed did not restore the position. See BUG-011.

Title: Don't Keep Activities
Steps:
1. Turn on Don't Keep Activities.
2. Walk Discover > show > Now Playing, pressing Home and returning at each step.
Expected Result: - Every screen restores correctly. No crash, no blank screens.
Actual Result: Two problems with Don't keep activities on. Playback restarts from 0:00 when the app comes back to the foreground (BUG-008). Separately, after pausing and leaving Now Playing, the notification shows the episode advancing with no audio - this one also happens with the setting off (BUG-009).

Title: Theme and font size changes
Steps:
1. Switch the system to dark mode, then to the largest font size.
2. Check every screen.
Expected Result:
- Audio continues.
- Nothing clipped or overlapping; both themes readable.

Title: Back stack
Steps:
1. Discover > show > Now Playing, then press back three times.
2. Repeat with the back gesture.
Expected Result:
- Show detail, Discover, then exits. No blank screens.
- Gesture behaves the same as the arrow.
Actual Result: Back walked the stack correctly from Now Playing to the show, to Discover, then out. Gesture behaved the same.

Title: Cold start with no network
Preconditions: Airplane mode on, app data wiped
Steps: 1. Turn airplane mode on and launch the app.
Expected Result:
- Clear error: "Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection." with a retry option.
- No endless spinner, no blank screen.
Actual Result: Offline cold start showed a clear error with a retry option - no endless spinner.

Title: Retry recovers
Steps: 1. Turn airplane mode off and tap Retry.
Expected Result: - Catalog loads. Error clears. No app restart needed.
Actual Result: Retry after restoring the network loaded the catalogue and cleared the error.

Title: Search and show detail while offline
Test Data: 'th', Science Weekly
Steps:
1. Go offline, search, then open a show.
2. Come back online and retry.
Expected Result:
- Both show an error with retry.
- Previously loaded content isn't wiped.
- Retry works.

Title: Losing network mid-playback
Test Data: AI Writes Our Show Notes Now
Steps: 1. Turn on airplane mode while listening. Keep watching for 30s.
Expected Result:
- Buffered audio plays out, then a clean pause.
- Timer must not keep ticking after the audio stops.

Title: Recovering after a mid-playback failure
Steps: 1. Turn airplane mode off and retry.

Actual Result: Turning airplane mode off did not bring playback back - no audio, no retry, and the timer was still moving. See BUG-010.

Title: Flapping connection

Expected Result: - No crash or ANR. Errors don't stack. Final state matches final connectivity.

Title: Offline error survives rotation

Expected Result: - Error and retry still there and still working.
